ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
title: Last Date for Submission of Nominations for Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar 2026 is 31st July,2026
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Women and Child Development

Last Date for Submission of Nominations for Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar 2026 is 31st July,2026

Nominations can be submitted online only via  official Rashtriya Puraskar Portal: https://awards.gov.in
Detailed step-by-step instructions available in  “Registration and Nomination Process for PMRBP” document on  PMRBP 2026 portal page

Posted On:
02 JUN 2026 3:51PM by PIB Delhi

The Government of India has opened nominations for the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar (PMRBP) 2026, a prestigious honour conferred by the President of India to children who have made exceptional contributions in various fields. The last date for submission is 31
st
 July 2026.

Nominations can be submitted online only via the official Rashtriya Puraskar Portal:
https://awards.gov.in
.

Children aged 5 to 18 years (as on 31
st
 July 2026) are eligible. Nominations can be made by any individual or institution, and children may also self-nominate.

The PMRBP is conferred in six categories:

Bravery

Social Service

Environment

Sports

Art & Culture

Science & Technology

To apply, one has to register or log in at
https://awards.gov.in
and provide essential details of the applicant like name, DOB, Aadhaar, mobile number, email ID, etc. Please select “Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar 2026” under the Ongoing Nominations section, Click “Nominate/Apply Now” and choose the relevant award category and indicate if the nomination is for self or another child.

The application form requires details of the nominee, a write-up (up to 1000-words) on the achievement and its impact, supporting documents and a recent photograph (jpg/jpeg/png).

Detailed step-by-step instructions are available in the “Registration and Nomination Process for PMRBP” document under the Notification tab on the PMRBP 2026 portal page.

Applications can be saved as drafts and edited before final submission. Once submitted, a downloadable copy is generated for records.

This award is a lifetime recognition that puts young achievers on the National stage. For detailed guidelines and previous winners, visit:

Nomination Portal:
https://awards.gov.in

Past Awardees:
https://awards.gov.in/Awardee

The Ministry urges all parents, teachers, organisations and citizens to help deserving children apply or get nominated for this honour.
